# TFCat fixture

`cassini_faraday_patches_2006_excerpt.json` holds two of the 60 features of
`cassini_faraday_patches_2006.json`, unchanged, with the file's own header (crs, fields,
properties):

Taubenschuss, U., Cecconi, B., & Lamy, L. (2021). Catalogue of Faraday Rotation patches
identified in Saturn Kilometric Radiation (SKR) observations by Cassini/RPWS/HFR
(Version 1.0) [Data set]. PADC. https://doi.org/10.25935/R11G-6J63
